horses.name: Blaze
dialogue: Hi!
Real quick, can you help me find a movie?
I don't usually have a lot of time for movies. So when I watch one, I want it to be good.
I'm a race horse, you see, so I'm always training.
I like movies that are extra exciting! Something that really gets the blood pumping!
checkout: I'm gonna run home and watch it now!

horses.name: Princess
dialogue: Hello sweet angel.
Why am I so beautiful, you ask?
Well I am a unicorn! From a land far far away.
What a fantastic store you have here!
Would a charming soul like you have a movie recommendation for me?
I love all different kinds of far away fantasy worlds!
Ohhh, I can't wait to see what kind of magic is hidden in these tapes!
checkout: I'm sure that with this movie I can live happily ever after.

horses.name: Major
dialogue: How you doing?
Major Major at your service.
Ah, the police work is not what it used to be back in the day.
I used to chase down gangsters! I used to love a good gangster! Now it's all just noise complaints, speeding, tresspassing...
Where is the thrill in that? You get me, kid.
Now, about the movie...
checkout: Thanks, kid. I'll give this a shot.

horses.name: Noir
horses.movie: Sherlock Hooves: Murder of Lady Nightmare
dialogue: Hello.
I have no clue if you have something for me...
You see, I am trying to write a mystery novel, but I am a bit stuck.
I can't seem to think of a good motive. Do you have any ideas for me?
checkout: I do hope it's no red herring...

horses.name: Vivienne
dialogue: Oy bruv!
What a lovely li'l store. There's all kinds of bits n' bobs in here, innit?
Well, I'm lookin' for a romance. A nice right classy one, if you please.

horses.name: Ol' Hooves
dialogue: Howdy!
Eh, my old bones need to rest, so I thought why not watch a movie.
See, I've traveled all through the west.
Seen a lot of things, heard a lot of stories.
I'm looking for a movie that reminds me of that life. But it better be accurate!

horses.name: Le Cheval
dialogue: Salutations.
I'm a knight in case you haven't noticed. I fought in many battles.
But I have a war in my head now.
You see, I cannot find a good movie to match my tastes.
I want a real epic tale. Nothing too down to earth, I don't like to be reminded of the things I've seen.
Do you have anything for me?
checkout: Thank you for having my back.

horses.name: Peanut
dialogue: Knock knock, who's there?
Hehe, I'm just messing around.
I do love to joke around, but I might be a little unstable...
Don't mean to stirrup any drama.
Anyway, you got something for me? Mane-stream or going against the rein?
Anything funny will do, but I definitely prefer the extra wacky.
checkout: Thanks, I will not say neigh to this!
